BULK ADD

Choose one operation. Category / Subcategory creation and Item creation are separate flows.

CATEGORY / SUBCATEGORY BULK IMPORT

Create Categories and Subcategories in Firebase from one Excel/CSV file. Categories are created first, then their Subcategories. Each row can have its own WEBP image. This flow creates taxonomy only; it does not create Items.

1. PREPARE TAXONOMY FILE
Columns: Type, Parent Category, Name, Slug, WEBP Image URL / Path, Active, Sort Order.
2. UPLOAD FILE
Supported: .xlsx, .xls, .csv
ROWS0
VALID0
ERRORS0
DUPLICATES0
ITEM BULK IMPORT

Category + Subcategory must already exist in Firebase. This flow creates Items only. It never creates Categories or Subcategories. If either name is missing or does not exactly match the existing Firebase taxonomy, that row remains ERROR and cannot be imported.

1. PREPARE ITEM EXCEL
Required: Category, Subcategory, Item Name, WEBP Image URL / Path. HSN Code is optional.
Specifications use paired columns: Spec 1 Name / Spec 1 Value, Spec 2 Name / Spec 2 Value…
COLOUR VARIANTS are supported in bulk: use Colour Variants with values separated by |, or use Colour Variant 1, Colour Variant 2, Colour Variant 3… columns. The same variant data is saved to the Item as colourVariants, exactly like the single-item form.
VARIANT TEMPLATE: Example: Black|White|Silver in Colour Variants, or separate variant columns. Unlimited variant columns are accepted by the importer.
2. UPLOAD ITEM FILE
Supported: .xlsx, .xls, .csv
